newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks rise on GDR-related stocks.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks rise on GDR-related stocks.

text.p: Pakistani stocks rose on Friday on the back of global depositary receipt-related stocks, dealers said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 8.11 points, or 0.51 percent, to 1,590.39 in the first two hours of trade. Gainers led losers 127 to 91.
PTCL gained 0.50 rupee to 30.65 on jobbers buying after its GDR rate rose to 72.50/75.50 from 71/75, Hub Power added 0.15 to 37.60 and Dewan Salman 1.00 to 39.30.
Lever Brothers rose 5.00 to 709 and Dawood Hercules 3.00 to 153. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
